title: test_auth_login_with_valid_credentials
description: Verify that POST /api/auth/login with valid user credentials returns a 200 status and a valid JWT token.

title: test_pg_property_update_with_owner_token
description: Verify that PUT /api/pg/property with a valid owner Bearer token updates the property information and returns a 200 status with updated settings.

title: test_tenants_create_with_owner_token
description: Verify that POST /api/tenants with owner Bearer token and valid tenant details creates a new tenant record and returns a 201 status.

title: test_rent_generate_with_owner_token
description: Verify that POST /api/rent/generate with owner Bearer token triggers monthly rent bill generation and returns a 200 status with generated bills.

title: test_payment_create_order_with_valid_rent_reference
description: Verify that POST /api/payment/create-order with Bearer token and valid rent reference returns a 200 status with Razorpay order details.

title: test_complaints_file_new_complaint
description: Verify that POST /api/complaints with Bearer token and valid complaint details creates a new complaint ticket and returns a 201 status.

title: test_announcements_publish_with_owner_token
description: Verify that POST /api/announcements with owner Bearer token and valid announcement content publishes the announcement and returns a 201 status.

title: test_notifications_fetch_for_authenticated_user
description: Verify that GET /api/notifications with valid Bearer token returns a 200 status with the current user's notifications.

title: test_analytics_dashboard_summary_with_authentication
description: Verify that GET /api/analytics/dashboard-summary with valid Bearer token returns a 200 status with dashboard KPIs.
